content: this legal text summarizes the progress of a legal case that started on october 17th 2022 the case involves a husband and wife and the court has found the husbands claim regarding four loans made by his father during their marriage to be admissible these loans were intended to help the couple settle their joint debts the court accepted the husbands claim based on certain legal principles and articles of the civil code the court also ordered further examination of evidence and arguments related to the sale of a property the value of a vehicle and rewards linked to donations and loans made by the husbands father overall the court upheld the husbands claim for the loans and emphasized the importance of resolving joint financial obligations fairly the court examined evidence such as writings claims and account statements to determine the existence of loans the court found sufficient evidence to support the existence of loans and discussed the impact of these loans on the division of debts the court also discussed the obligations of each spouse in the marriage and the possibility of nullifying certain financial transactions the court acknowledged that loans were taken by the husband and that both spouses should participate in the repayment of joint debts the exact amount of the loans is not clear but the court will consider a provisional sum for the division of debts the text also discusses various legal aspects related to a matrimonial regime including the creation of profit for the joint patrimony and the use of loans for the joint patrimony the text mentions the possibility of reopening debates and calculates the occupancy indemnity based on the property being undivided upon divorce the text also mentions the expenses assumed by one party in the divorce and the contribution of the other party to these expenses the text briefly mentions other contradicted aspects and reserves the costs the case involves a husband and wife and the court has found the husbands claim regarding loans made by his father to be admissible the court discusses the conditions for bringing a claim and the admissibility of the spouses request for payment of a debt owed to a third party the court determines that the husband has standing to bring the claim and that the debt can be registered as a liability of the community the text concludes by mentioning other court cases
